name: Warren Elder
description: {3}{W}: Creatures you control get +1/+1 until end of turn.
couldNotDerive: The activation cost {3}{W} -- node C has no cost node/flag feeding it at all, so the examiner correctly flagged the ability as ungated with an unknown trigger/cost mechanism.
notes: Real gap: AB$ PumpAll with a plain mana-only Cost$ ("{3}{W}: Creatures you control get +1/+1") has no cost handling at all -- the generic tap-cost handler only recognizes Cost$ strings containing T (a tap component); a pure-mana activated-ability cost with no tap and no Sac<> falls through completely uncosted, same class of gap noted much earlier this session for Pump ("a smaller, separate open gap" -- still open, now confirmed hit by a real card). Not fixed this round -- would need extending the tap-cost handler (or adding a parallel mana-only-cost handler) to build a cost-bearing node even without a tap component.
